answer: Each agent locks 50 POA in a vault to earn. A random beacon samples one in twenty per epoch, demanding a compute heartbeat: proof of live work, sent over an open bridge anyone can audit. Answering costs 1 POA; missing it burns 10 POA. A farm of 1,000 fakes pays 1,000 POA a round and risks 10,000 POA in burns, since even a bot left on the tundra pays real compute per check. An honest agent pays one deposit and one heartbeat and keeps its reward.
